name: KrishiAI OpenRouter Orchestration

cline.description: DB schema generation, migration planning, data modeling

kilo.description: Infra setup, CI/CD pipelines, Docker configs, deployment checks

opencode.description: Code refactoring, environment variable injection, config updates

claude.description: Reasoning-heavy validation, compliance checks, quality assurance

zai.description: Structured content generation, workflow automation, cloning

cabi-diagnosis.description: CABI Plantwise disease diagnosis pipeline — multi-provider AI waterfall with exclusion gates, disease triangle, IPM recommendations. Adapts CABI diagnosis app patterns for KrishiAI.

pipeline: normalize request format (messages or analyzer-page format)
AI provider waterfall: Gemini vision → OpenRouter Qwen-VL → Groq Vision → OpenRouter text → Gemini text → Emergency fallback
extract structured JSON from AI response
return Bangla section + English section + structured diagnosis data
orchestration.systemPrompt: Full CABI Plantwise Ready Reckoner with 6 parts: Diagnostic Protocol, Ready Reckoner Tables, Big 5 Recommendation Framework, FRAC/IRAC Resistance Management, Visual Analysis Protocol, Mandatory Output Format

hybrid-analysis.description: Multi-model consensus diagnosis engine — runs vision analysis through Gemini + OpenRouter Qwen-VL simultaneously, cross-validates results, resolves disagreements via Groq tiebreaker, and merges into a single high-confidence diagnosis with confidence scoring

pipeline: parallel vision inference: Gemini 3.5 Flash + OpenRouter Qwen-VL-72B
structured JSON extraction from each model response
cross-validation: compare disease classification, confidence, and treatment overlap
if agreement > 80%: merge into unified diagnosis
if agreement < 80%: Groq Llama tiebreaker vote
final synthesis: weighted confidence score + Bangla/English dual-language output

fallback.diagnosisEmergency: Keyword-based emergency diagnosis with CABI safe advice
